change_summary: The journal has retracted this paper because its survey data were unreliable. The notice says the conclusions cannot be relied on. This affects the whole paper, including its main finding that heavy social media use was linked to higher loneliness in 1,000 adolescents. Anyone citing it as support should treat it as unreliable.
evaluation: Your draft cites Ivanov and Dubois (2017) once, in the Introduction, as one of three sources showing that adolescents' online lives have been studied. The journal retracted the whole paper because its survey data were unreliable, so this citation is affected. It is only background and your interview study of 20 students on friendships during exams does not rely on its findings. Impact is low, but you should still remove the reference or cite it as retracted.
recommendation: The journal retracted the whole paper over unreliable survey data, but your draft cites it only once, as background in the Introduction. Remove the citation (or replace it), or keep it and flag it as retracted. Your interview study doesn't depend on the paper's findings.
